Sam: Morning team — wild stat: monthly requests doubled overnight. :tada:
Mira: wait what?? confirm?
Sam: Confirmed via dashboard. Pinged infra and it's healthy. This calls for stickers + something edible. :confetti_ball:
Jia: Stickers! Can we do neon ones? also small online swag for remote folks pls.
Oliver: I volunteer to design a tiny mascot sticker (sleepy redwood squirrel?)
Tanvi: @Sam pizza truck or croissants? vote: 🍕 or 🥐
Lina: Croissants for me pls. Also can we have a 5-min "gong & shout" on standup?
Sam: Love the gong idea. We have the brass bell in kitchen — short ring at 10:15. Remote ppl: I'll mail stickers + Mentos (lol) and reimburse.
Deploy Bot: Alert: production traffic spike detected at 2025-11-02T08:31:30Z — autoscaler handled 2.3x baseline. No errors.
Mira: :party_parrot: Amazing work y'all. Can someone make a tiny 1-slide brag for homepage?
Jia: I'll make a quick "we doubled monthly requests" slide and share here.
Oliver: :thumbsup: I can mock up sticker art and post options in #design.
Tanvi: Poll: pizza or croissants? React with 🍕 or 🥐. Also suggest sticker color? neon green vs hot pink. React with 🟢 or 🔴.
Sam: Also shoutout to infra on-call — @Oliver, @Jia for keeping latencies under SLO. Big thanks. :heart:
Mira: :balloon: team lunch at 12 if people are in-office. Remote drop a lunch gift card preference.
